title: Testing Apple's Touch ID with Fake Fingerprints
summary: Tested explains how Apple's Touch ID recognizes fingerprints, then tries to defeat it using fake fingers and prints, retracing methods claimed by a German computer club.
why: Used as evidence that fingerprint unlocking can be spoofed with fairly simple fabricated copies.
